questions.question: Microservices vs Monolith — trade-offs?

options.B: Monolith: đơn giản, dễ develop/debug ban đầu. Microservices: scale independently, tech diversity, team autonomy — nhưng phức tạp hơn (network, distributed transactions, observability)

questions.explanation: Monolith advantages: simple deployment, easy debugging, no network latency between components, ACID transactions. When to microservices: team > 10-15 engineers, different scaling requirements per component, different release cycles, polyglot needs. Microservices problems: distributed system complexity, network failures, service discovery, distributed transactions (Saga pattern), data consistency (eventual), observability (need distributed tracing). Martin Fowler: 'Don't start with microservices'. Start monolith, extract services khi necessary (Strangler Fig Pattern).

questions.question: Saga pattern cho distributed transactions trong microservices?

options.B: Saga: chuỗi local transactions, mỗi bước publish event. Choreography: event-driven. Orchestration: central coordinator. Compensating transactions khi fail

questions.explanation: Distributed transaction problem: Order + Inventory + Payment service cần atomic. 2PC (Two-Phase Commit): coordinator, blocking, không practical trong microservices. Saga: chuỗi local transactions + compensating transactions nếu fail. Choreography: mỗi service emit event → next service reacts. Decentralized, hard to track. Orchestration: Saga orchestrator (separate service) gọi từng service, handle failures. Easier to track. Compensating transaction: undo completed steps (refund payment, restore inventory). Eventual consistency — không ACID.

questions.question: API Gateway pattern trong microservices?

options.A: Client gọi trực tiếp từng service
options.B: API Gateway: single entry point, route to services, cross-cutting concerns (auth, rate limit, logging, SSL). BFF pattern: gateway per client type
options.C: API Gateway thay thế load balancer

questions.explanation: API Gateway responsibilities: (1) Routing: /users → user-service, /orders → order-service. (2) Auth: validate JWT once, không mỗi service. (3) Rate limiting: per client. (4) SSL termination. (5) Request/response transformation. (6) Logging + tracing. (7) Circuit breaker. BFF (Backend for Frontend): dedicated gateway per frontend type (mobile BFF, web BFF, 3rd party BFF) — different data shapes. Tools: Kong, AWS API Gateway, nginx, Traefik, Spring Cloud Gateway. Service Mesh (Istio): sidecars handle cross-cutting, không cần centralized gateway.

questions.question: Circuit Breaker pattern — implement với Resilience4j?

options.B: Circuit Breaker: CLOSED (normal) → OPEN (failures > threshold, fast-fail) → HALF-OPEN (test) → CLOSED. Prevents cascade failures

questions.explanation: Circuit Breaker states: CLOSED: requests flow normally, track failures. OPEN: nếu failure rate > threshold (50%), fail fast với fallback, không call downstream. HALF-OPEN: sau timeout, allow test requests. If success → CLOSED. If fail → OPEN. Resilience4j: @CircuitBreaker(name='paymentService', fallbackMethod='paymentFallback'). Config: slidingWindowSize:10, failureRateThreshold:50, waitDurationInOpenState:10s. Combined với: Retry (@Retry), Timeout (@TimeLimiter), Bulkhead. Netflix Hystrix (deprecated) → Resilience4j. Prevents: cascade failures, thundering herd after recovery.

questions.question: Service A calls B calls C — cascade failure khi C down?

options.B: Circuit Breakers tại mỗi call, Bulkhead (isolate thread pools), Fallback, Timeout, Retry với exponential backoff — Defense in depth

questions.explanation: Cascade failure: A → B → C (C down) → B threads exhausted waiting → B down → A down. Prevention: (1) Timeout: B wait max 1s cho C. (2) Circuit Breaker: sau N failures, B fast-fail without calling C. (3) Bulkhead: separate thread pools per downstream service, C problems không exhaust all of B's threads. (4) Fallback: return cached data, default value, or error message gracefully. (5) Retry: với exponential backoff + jitter để tránh thundering herd. (6) Health checks: load balancer không route đến unhealthy. (7) Observability: alert khi error rate tăng trước khi cascade.
